description: This file defines a ViewComponent class 'Basket' for rendering a shopping basket component in an ASP.NET Core web application. It interacts with services to get basket item counts and handles both signed-in and anonymous users.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A ViewComponent for displaying and managing the state of the shopping basket, handling both authenticated and anonymous users.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates the view model with the total number of items in the basket and returns the view.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Counts total basket items for the signed-in user or anonymous user based on available identifiers.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the anonymous user ID from cookies if available, validating it as a GUID.
